assumptions: All hosts are finite simple split graphs with one shared capacity per actual core edge; aggregate variables are not duplicated by maximal-clique descriptions.
The low-total theorem fixes eta before choosing the sufficiently-large threshold and invokes a recent source-backed dense triangle-decomposition theorem on the residual core order r.
The nine-seed lift requires m=3^h and x+y<=m-1; it is a separate explicit family, not a proof for arbitrary medium/high parameters.
Q has integral core triangles but may retain fractional aggregate leaf allocations; Q, J, nu, L_D and J_fix remain distinct.

atomic_claims.text: For every finite two-prefix split host with core order r, Q-nu is at most a+r+floor(a/2)+floor(r/2), hence at most 3r, independently of the leaf multiplicities. The proof first rounds the leaf polytope after fixing an integer core and then pays one edge-color deficiency per aggregate class.
For r=3^k, k>=2, p=q=3 and every actual short set A, a globally reselected two-direction affine construction is an actual host packing with leave r+a+2(a mod 3), at most 2r+4.

For every fixed eta>0 and all sufficiently large odd r, if p is within the complete-graph matching-class cap and p+q<=(1/4-eta)r, then an actual packing leaves at most r+8+p+q edges. The final dense core decomposition uses Delcourt-Postle arXiv:2606.11178v1, Corollary 1.5, as a source-backed input.
The exact nine-core saturated seed lifts for m=3^h to r=9m,a=3m,p=2m+x,q=4m+y,x+y<=m-1, with L-Q equal to [3m parity(x+y)+6m parity(y)]/6 and an actual gap below 13r/6 after the universal conversion.
Combining the low-total growing theorem with the previously drafted chordal lambda bound yields cp(G)<=B(N)+2(N+8)/3 on the covered split subclass; this is not a root closure.

Five generator-side runs record complete fixed-three cardinality and nine-subset checks, complete m=1,3 seed lifts, bounded dense preprocessing, all labeled graphs through five vertices for rho, twelve mutations, and an independent tuple-vector/NetworkX/SciPy crosscheck.

objective: Remove multiplicity dependence from the two-level Q-to-host conversion, prove an actual-packing theorem for arbitrary growing p,q below a fixed quarter-density margin, and supply a source-free high-multiplicity saturated-seed family; keep the complete one-third face and both admitted stronger obligations open.
risks: Delcourt-Postle arXiv:2606.11178v1 is a June 2026 preprint and has no registered source attestation or trusted verifier receipt in this transaction.
The complete low-long one-third face is not covered. The balanced stress profile a approximately r/2 and p=q approximately 2r/5 remains outside the new domains.
The universal Q-to-host conversion is at most 3r; it does not prove a uniform bound for L-Q.
The finite runs and independent-library crosscheck share the generator trust domain and do not prove the all-order statements.
The clique-partition corollary additionally depends on the candidate C22 lambda bound; no EvidenceLink, Result, Solution or closure is produced.
